quest.title: The Still Water's Flow
quest.description: The now-awakened Enkanomiya calls out to a hero. Beneath the still waters lies a new realm.
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x200, Primogem x30, Hero's Wit x2, Mora x20000

dialogues.speaker: Tsuyuko
dialogues.text: #Hello there, {NICKNAME}.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hey there, Tsuyuko. How have your preparations for getting that coral thingamajig gone?

dialogues.speaker: Tsuyuko
dialogues.text: Ah, alas, our work has been... troubled thus far.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: You know, Tsuyuko, you can make as sad a face as you want...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: But you're not convincing anyone if you keep glancing at us meaningfully like that!

dialogues.speaker: Tsuyuko
dialogues.text: Aha, I see. So you, too, have realized the severity of our situation. In that case, I shall hide it no longer.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: You weren't hiding anything in the first place!

dialogues.speaker: Tsuyuko
dialogues.text: We did obtain the Key of the Moon-Bathed Deep, yes, and Enkanomiya is slowly awakening. However, we are quite short on manpower. As such, our investigations are proceeding at a slow pace.

dialogues.speaker: Tsuyuko
dialogues.text: These are uniquely trying circumstances, after all. We do not yet know if relations with Narukami Island will indeed warm.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You know I'm only one pair of hands, right?

dialogues.speaker: Tsuyuko
dialogues.text: Ah, but that is a different matter. Know that according to tradition, a "hero" is vital to the process of obtaining the coral.

dialogues.speaker: Tsuyuko
dialogues.text: We must set up a base and assist the hero in retracing the paths of our ancestors, before finally facing the trial.

dialogues.speaker: Tsuyuko
dialogues.text: In this manner, we shall build a steady road to victory...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Or that was your plan, anyway — and you can't carry it out because you lack the people.

dialogues.speaker: Tsuyuko
dialogues.text: That is absolutely correct. Not to mention how we have seen neither hide nor hair of our most vital character, this "hero."

dialogues.speaker: Tsuyuko
dialogues.text: But wait, I think I see it now. Our hero has... Yes, our hero has a head of blond hair!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ugh, this sounds super troublesome. Paimon doesn't think making this trip is a great idea.

dialogues.speaker: Tsuyuko
dialogues.text: Ah, but exploration usually leads to the discovery of rare treasure. I mean, such things would usually be given over to the Sangonomiya Clan, of course.

dialogues.speaker: Tsuyuko
dialogues.text: But if you were to find something, why, I suppose we could simply close one eye in this case...

choices.text: I wouldn't mind if you closed both eyes.

response.speaker: Tsuyuko
response.text: Ah, our hero, our gallant warrior, our paragon, our savior! Does this mean that you agree, then?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Ah well, how could we leave Sangonomiya in such a time of crisis, right?

response.speaker: Tsuyuko
response.text: Wonderful! It certainly seems that the methods recommended by Madam Kokomi are quite persuasive indeed.

response.speaker: Tsuyuko
response.text: She even anticipated that you would indeed return to look for me.

response.speaker: Tsuyuko
response.text: Oh, nothing, nothing. In that case, please come with me. I would like to show you something.

response.speaker: Tsuyuko
response.text: Let us meet up at the altar below the area ahead of us. If you can't see it...

response.speaker: Tsuyuko
response.text: Then just look to the southeast and squint.

choices.text: You know, I think we and Madam Kokomi get along pretty well and all...

talks.objective: Talk to Tsuyuko at the altar

dialogues.speaker: Tsuyuko
dialogues.text: We call this a "Key Sigil." It was once heraldry used throughout Enkanomiya. It only resurfaces when the road is about to be opened.

dialogues.speaker: Tsuyuko
dialogues.text: This is said to be a second set of keys that are sent to the people of Watatsumi Island when Enkanomiya awakens, and our records show that there are a total of five types of Key Sigils.

dialogues.speaker: Tsuyuko
dialogues.text: At the moment, we have found three of the five on Watatsumi Island. We can then operate them in this manner to return them to their proper places and release the seal.

dialogues.speaker: Tsuyuko
dialogues.text: We removed the three we found from their keyholes and placed them in other locations throughout Watatsumi Island. This way, the barrier can be restored.

dialogues.speaker: Tsuyuko
dialogues.text: The purpose behind doing that, of course, was to prevent children, Fatui spies, Narukami Islanders or outlanders from sneaking inside.

dialogues.speaker: Tsuyuko
dialogues.text: Um, you're not in that "outlanders" category, don't worry. Ahaha...

dialogues.speaker: Tsuyuko
dialogues.text: We are presently unable to establish contact with the Adventurers' Guild, so no adventurers are allowed down there either.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Did you ever let them go down there anyway?

dialogues.speaker: Tsuyuko
dialogues.text: There are such historical records. We were looking for a win-win arrangement, you understand. It is always good to have people whose strong suit is exploration around — yourself included.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oho, so this means that no one's stolen a march on us this time, right?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Whoa, Paimon, manners...

dialogues.speaker: Tsuyuko
dialogues.text: Well, how should I put this? I doubt that our temporary barrier restoration was completely foolproof. Some time did pass between our investigating the Key Sigils' locations and removing them from the keyholes, so some rats may have scurried in during the interim.

dialogues.speaker: Tsuyuko
dialogues.text: We are short on manpower, after all. In short, if you encounter any Fatui, Treasure Hoarders, Kairagi, or any of their ilk... Feel free to teach them a lesson.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wait a minute. If they got down there so easily, what was the point of us getting that Moon-Caked-Whatever again?

dialogues.speaker: Tsuyuko
dialogues.text: Enkanomiya will only awaken if we retrieve the Key of the Moon-Bathed Deep. Similarly, only that Key can activate the trial system within.

dialogues.speaker: Tsuyuko
dialogues.text: And if there are any who did not enter Enkanomiya to perform the Watatsumi Goryou Matsuri... Well, there might be some other twisted, winding way to get in. Who knows?

dialogues.speaker: Tsuyuko
dialogues.text: Either way, please retrieve the other Key Sigils on the island with all haste.

dialogues.speaker: Tsuyuko
dialogues.text: The Key Sigils have been placed at the Fin and Heart of Watatsumi. As for their two altars, they can be found at the line that connects either shrine and Sangonomiya Shrine, which intersects with the second mountain wall that surrounds the Moon-Bathed Deep.

dialogues.speaker: Tsuyuko
dialogues.text: Well then, I'll wait for news from you at the usual place.

dialogues.speaker: Tsuyuko
dialogues.text: #Anything else you wish to ask me, {NICKNAME}?

response.speaker: Tsuyuko
response.text: We've placed them at the Fin and Heart of Watatsumi.

response.speaker: Tsuyuko
response.text: Honestly, we just tried to find a compromise between distance and stealth, and those two shrines happened to be in decently concealed locations.

choices.text: Where do I find the altars?

response.speaker: Tsuyuko
response.text: You can find them to the north and to the east. They are located along the second mountain wall that surrounds the Moon-Bathed Deep.

response.speaker: Tsuyuko
response.text: If you draw two lines between Sangonomiya Shrine and the Fin and Heart of Watatsumi...

response.speaker: Tsuyuko
response.text: Then connect those lines with the arc of the mountain wall, you should get two positions. That's where the altars are.

talks.objective: Look for the remaining Key Sigils

dialogues.speaker: Tsuyuko
dialogues.text: #Anything else you wish to ask me, {NICKNAME}?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About Byakuyakoku...

dialogues.speaker: Tsuyuko
dialogues.text: Enkanomiya's name was Byakuyakoku once upon a time. There was neither sun nor moon in that underground realm, and the only two astronomical phenomena being the Whitenight and the Evernight.

dialogues.speaker: Tsuyuko
dialogues.text: One of my ancestors was a shrine maiden named Eboshi. She was a character of some significance in Byakuyakoku's history, and it is due to her that I am in charge of the Watatsumi Goryou Matsuri.

talks.objective: Look for the remaining Key Sigils
Follow Tsuyuko's instructions and activate all the altars
Follow Tsuyuko's instructions and activate all the altars

dialogues.speaker: Tsuyuko
dialogues.text: Now is the time to release the seal. Here, take the Key of the Moon-Bathed Deep you retrieved before.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Say that again?

dialogues.speaker: Tsuyuko
dialogues.text: Key of the Moon-Bathed Deep.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Say that again three times fast?

dialogues.speaker: Tsuyuko
dialogues.text: Key of the Moon-Bathed Deep, Key of the Moon-Bathed Deep, Key of the Doom-Bathed Meep... Gah! Okay, it's a bit of a tongue-twister.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: See? Paimon told you that it was a weird name! You should consider changing it.

dialogues.speaker: Tsuyuko
dialogues.text: Eh, even if we do change its name today, it'll only be important again a few centuries down the line. Just bear with it for now.

dialogues.speaker: Tsuyuko
dialogues.text: *cough* Either way. I'm going to begin the ritual now.

dialogues.speaker: Tsuyuko
dialogues.text: Unfortunately, we do not have any details as to the nature of Enkanomiya's trial, so you will have to rely on yourself there.

dialogues.speaker: Tsuyuko
dialogues.text: If we must blame anything, we should blame stupid traditions that are supposed to "preserve mysteries." I wish you good luck.

dialogues.speaker: Tsuyuko
dialogues.text: Also, please do not push yourself too hard. Your safety is of utmost importance.
